item.title: [Infraestrutura] CVE-2026-126378 - Nginx
item.description:
🚨 CVE-2026-126378 - Nginx
 
Criticidade: Crítica
Ferramenta: Nginx
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 9.1
Resumo:
Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains a file upload vulnerability in the theme installer validFile() function that uses strpos() instead of strict path matching. Attackers with admin credentials can upload a ZIP containing a PHP file whose path includes /theme.php to achieve remote code execution on nginx deployments.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-126378

item.description:

Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Elastic
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 7.1
Resumo:
The Elasticsearch data source resource proxy forwards the request method and path to Elasticsearch using the data source's own credentials, without restricting them to the operations the plugin needs. A user who can query the data source can alter index mappings or reach other indices on the cluster.

Resumo:
